results.description: Isabella Lövin signing climate law referral
results.text: The referral of the Swedish climate law is signed by Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for International Development Cooperation and Climate Isabella Lövin. All future governments will be obliged to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. For a better planet and a better future. From left to right: Isabella Lövin, Deputy Prime Minister; Ulrika Modéer, State Secretary; Eva Svedling, State Secretary; Annika Flensburg, Press Secretary; Mikaela Kotschack, Press Secretary; Katarina Hellström, Political Adv Isabella Lövin signing climate law referral
